name: JK Lakshmi Cement Ltd
title: JK Lakshmi Cement Ltd - 500380 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Capacity additions hit a record 64 Mt in FY26 with utilisation near 69%, and management expects Q1 FY27 cost pressure of INR100-130/t with only partial price recovery, so margins face a near-term squeeze.

utilisation.quote: pan-India capacity utilization estimated to be at around 69% and marginally lower than previous year

capex.peers_comment: Industry capacity addition of 64 million tons in FY26; management expects 45-50 Mt in FY27 and that capacity addition may slow.
capex.quote: We expect total capex in FY27 to be around INR1,500 crores to INR1,700 crores and close to INR2,000 crores in the next year

triggers.label: Industry capacity add 64Mt in FY26
triggers.quote: Supply side witnessed highest ever annual capacity addition of 64 million tons
triggers.highlight: highest ever annual capacity addition of 64 million tons

triggers.label: Cost pass-through short by INR120-130/t
triggers.quote: INR100 to INR120 or INR130 a ton

triggers.label: March growth slowed to ~5%
triggers.quote: moderated during March, which is estimated at around 5% due to weak sentiment

guidance.quote: FY26-'27 cement demand is going likely to grow at about 6% or so
we are going to grow higher than the industry in FY 27 as well
We expect total capex in FY27 to be around INR1,500 crores to INR1,700 crores
close to INR2,000 crores in the next year
we are reasonably confident that we'll achieve 30 million ton by 2030
I think maybe next quarter, I'll update you

red_flags.label: Mining rights written off INR325 crore
Assam limestone MDO cancelled; INR130 crore receivable pending
red_flags.quote: We are saying that the next hearing is in July

evasions.quote: I think quite uncertain. I think maybe next quarter, I'll update you.
We'll not get -- we are not saying that it will come in July.
